- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods; reduce forecast peak values when sentiment is positive or trending up.
- Underestimate prices during negative sentiment; increase forecast lows when sentiment is negative or trending down.
- Overshoot after sharp price spikes; cap forecast peaks at 10–15% below the immediate prior high if sentiment is volatile or uncertain.
- Mean-revert forecasts toward recent 7–14 day average if sentiment is neutral or mixed, especially after prolonged directional bias.
- Lag errors are common in early forecast windows; adjust for 1–2 day delay in price reaction to sentiment shifts, especially in high volatility periods.
- Avoid overfitting to recent highs; if sentiment is trending down, reduce forecast momentum even if historical data shows upward bias.
